mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 1.0% in 20-day windows where returns are negative in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals labor market weakness, prompting equity sell-offs due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.5% but 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production declining below 100 while housing starts rising above 1150 indicates supply-demand imbalance favoring economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 and HOUST > 1150 but 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 1.5% during monetary tightening cycles compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 1.5% but 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1150 units indicate robust consumer demand, driving retail sales growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1150 but 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 but 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales growth exceeding 1% while CPI remains below 245 indicates stable inflation and strong consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth > 1% and CPIAUCSL < 245 but 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Employment growth exceeding 146,000 persons during late-cycle expansion signals sustained labor market strength, supporting corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 146000 but 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances.
